annotations.title: Look up support status, end-of-life date and latest version for runtimes, frameworks, databases and Docker images (live)

description: Use when a version of a runtime, framework, database, OS or Docker image is about to be chosen or recommended, or the user asks whether a version is still supported, when it reaches end of life, what the latest version or current LTS is, or whether a Docker tag exists (signals: "which Node version should I use", "latest LTS", "is Python 3.9 still supported", "when does Postgres 14 go EOL", "is .NET 8 end of life", "latest Django", "does python:3.13-slim-trixie exist", "Ubuntu 22.04 support"). Each item is free text: "node 18", "python 3.9.18", "postgres:13-alpine" (an image), "django>=4.2", "ubuntu jammy", "lts/hydrogen", or just a product name ("nodejs") for its supported lines and current pick. Data is fetched live from endoflife.date (about 490 products: languages, frameworks, databases, operating systems, cloud and infrastructure software); image tags are checked on their registry. Returns per item the matched release line, status on today's date (supported, security fixes only, end of life, not released, no such version), LTS flag, end-of-life date and days left, paid extended support date, latest patch and whether the given version is behind it, the recommended line and the oldest still supported, and for images whether the tag exists plus a verified replacement. Example: {"items":["node 18","python:3.9-slim","postgres 14","nextjs 13.4.1","dotnet"]}. Up to 40 items. Products endoflife.date does not track are reported as unknown, not guessed; for a whole file use ripe_check_file.

as_of.description: Judge support status on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

check_tags.description: Check Docker image tags exist on their registry (and verify the suggested replacement tag). Default true.

items.description: Products and versions, one per item: "node 18", "python 3.12.4", "postgres:16-alpine", "django 5.1", "ubuntu 22.04", "dotnet" (product only).

warn_days.description: Warn when end of life is this many days away or less. Default 180.
